mapper.select: SELECT * FROM public.nocode_workflow_task_node WHERE execution_id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenant} AND deleted=false ORDER BY create_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM public.nocode_workflow_task_node WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenant} AND deleted=false
SELECT * FROM public.nocode_workflow_task_node WHERE execution_id=#{execution} AND process_instance_id=#{process} AND node_id=#{node} AND tenant_id=#{tenant} AND deleted=false
SELECT * FROM public.nocode_workflow_task_node WHERE task_id=#{rootId} AND tenant_id=#{tenant} AND deleted=false
SELECT * FROM public.nocode_workflow_task_node WHERE process_instance_id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenant} AND deleted=false ORDER BY create_time,id
SELECT * FROM public.nocode_workflow_task_node WHERE deleted=false AND state IN ('CREATING','WAITING') AND next_attempt_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY next_attempt_time,id LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE public.nocode_workflow_task_node SET task_id=#{row.taskId},state=#{row.state},last_error=#{row.lastError}, attempts=#{row.attempts},next_attempt_time=#{row.nextAttemptTime},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updater='workflow' WHERE id=#{row.id} AND tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} AND deleted=false
